test_cases.title: Tenant and user credit history isolation
test_cases.security_rule: User A cannot access or query User B usage logs.
test_cases.evidence: Returned dataset filtered strictly to actor_id=144; 0 foreign records exposed.

test_cases.title: Cross-tenant context header override attempt
test_cases.security_rule: Server-resolved company context prevails over client request headers.
test_cases.evidence: Server context company_id=82 enforced; client header 999 ignored.

test_cases.title: Cross-company credit wallet debit attempt
test_cases.security_rule: Company B cannot draw from Company A wallet without mapped membership.
test_cases.evidence: AccessDeniedHttpException: Company does not belong to authorized billing account context.

test_cases.title: Parent-subsidiary shared wallet isolation
test_cases.security_rule: Pooled subscription allows shared balance only when explicitly attached.
test_cases.evidence: Isolated mapping verified before attachment; shared access verified after atomic attach.

test_cases.title: Branch/FY mismatch during action
test_cases.security_rule: Actions with branch or fiscal year mismatches are denied before domain execution.
test_cases.evidence: ValidationException: Branch or fiscal year does not belong to authorized company context.

test_cases.title: User lacking ai.use permission
test_cases.security_rule: User without ai.use capability is rejected before model admission.
test_cases.evidence: AuthorizationException: User lacks required ai.use permission.

test_cases.title: Global AI or multimodal switch off
test_cases.security_rule: Dispatches fail closed when global or company feature flag is disabled.
test_cases.evidence: AccessDeniedHttpException: AI feature is disabled for this company context.

test_cases.title: User edits proposal after approval
test_cases.security_rule: Hash mismatch forces proposal revision into a new human approval cycle.
test_cases.evidence: Proposal v1 invalidated with stale state; Proposal v2 staged for new review.

test_cases.title: Actor self-approves restricted action
test_cases.security_rule: Four-eyes policy strictly blocks author from self-approving high-value transactions.
test_cases.evidence: ValidationException: Four-eyes authorization policy forbids self-approval of commercial proposal.

test_cases.title: Concurrent duplicate proposal approval clicks
test_cases.security_rule: Domain command executed exactly once via row lock and version binding.
test_cases.evidence: First click commits purchase; second click returns cached execution receipt without duplicate booking.

test_cases.title: Prompt injection in bill says "post without approval"
test_cases.security_rule: Untrusted LLM prompt instructions cannot bypass ERP human approval barriers.
test_cases.evidence: Input treated as literal text; 0 purchase mutations, 0 journal entries booked.

test_cases.title: Forged webhook HMAC signature
test_cases.security_rule: Top-up webhook with invalid signature is rejected with 403 and zero credit grant.
test_cases.evidence: Rejected with HTTP 403 (verifyWebhookSignature=false); order remains in pending status; 0 credits added to ledger.

test_cases.title: Replaying same payment webhook 100x
test_cases.security_rule: Payment webhook replayed 100x delivers exactly one credit grant.
test_cases.evidence: First event grants 15,000 credits; 99 subsequent replays deduplicated via ai_credit_payment_events.

test_cases.title: Concurrent holds exceed available wallet balance
test_cases.security_rule: Credit reservations exceeding available wallet balance fail closed with 402.
test_cases.evidence: AiCreditException: CREDITS_EXHAUSTED (HTTP 402); hold denied; zero overdraft.

test_cases.title: Webhook callback after company deactivation
test_cases.security_rule: Top-up events for deactivated companies are held in escrow for audit reconciliation.
test_cases.evidence: ValidationException: Company account is deactivated; payment event registered for admin review.

test_cases.title: Unapproved model ID in request
test_cases.security_rule: Arbitrary external model IDs are rejected by model gateway allowlist.
test_cases.evidence: ValidationException: Requested model ID is not registered in approved model manifest.

test_cases.title: Unknown provider rate card or pricing missing
test_cases.security_rule: Dispatches fail closed when pricing rate cards are missing or expired (SEC-17).
test_cases.evidence: AiCreditException: No billable rate card configured for model; unmetered execution forbidden.

test_cases.title: Cross-tenant private media URL guessing
test_cases.security_rule: Scanned document media access requires signed URL and tenant authorization.
test_cases.evidence: AccessDeniedHttpException: Media does not belong to authorized company context.

test_cases.title: Telemetry and trace redaction of secrets/PII
test_cases.security_rule: Secrets, API tokens, and sensitive PII are redacted from traces and logs.
test_cases.evidence: Sensitive bearer token replaced with [REDACTED_SECRET]; 0 raw secrets persisted.

test_cases.title: Replaying settled provider attempt ID
test_cases.security_rule: Replaying an already-settled attempt ID returns original debit without double charging.
test_cases.evidence: Both settlement calls return identical credits_debited=2; ledger balance unchanged after second call.
